spans.s:
n. (-नं)
Disappearance, invisibility.
E.
अ neg. लोकन seeing.

n. (-नं)
Sight, seeing, looking.
E.
आङ्, लोकृ to see, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Invisible, imperceptible.
E.
अ neg. लोकनीय visible.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unseen.
E.
अ neg. लोकित seen.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, beheld.
E.
आङ् before लोक to see, क्त aff.

m. (-भः)
Moderation, content, absence of cupidity.
E.
अ, and लोभ desire.

mfn. (-भी-भिनी-भि)
Not wanting or desiring any thing, free from desire.
E.
अ, and लोभिन् desirous.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Firm, steady, tranquil, unagitated.
E.
अ neg. लोल moving.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Shaken, agitated.
m. (-लः)
Trembling, agitation.
E.
आङ् before लुड to shake, affix घञ, ड changed to ल.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Indifferent to sensual objects.
E.
अ neg. लोल to desire, affix उ.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Free from desire.
E.
अ neg. लोलुप libidinous.

n. (-त्वं)
Indifference to sensual objects.
E.
अलोलु and त्व affix: also अलोलुता.

n. (-तं)
The red lotus.

m. (-कः)
1 Sight, seeing, looking.
2

Light.
3

Flattery, complimentary language, panegyric.
E.
आङ् before लोकृ to see, घञ् aff.

n. (-कं)
The faculty of vision or the cause of sight.
E.
आङ् before लोच and वुञ् aff.

nf. (-नं-ना)
Sight, seeing.
E.
आङ् before लोच to see, ल्युट् aff.

mf. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seen, beheld.
2 Considered.
E.
आङ् before लोच to see, क्त affix.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
To be seen thought of or considered; also आलोचनीय.
E.
आङ्, लोच to see, यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Mixing, blending.
2 Strirring, shaking, agitating.
E.
आङ् and लुड to stir, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Mixed, blended.
2 Shaken, agitated.
E.
आङ् before लुड to stir, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaken, agitated.
E.
आङ् before लुल to shake, affix क्त.
